selection: Resolve exact IDs from the actual connected harness/provider catalog before assignment; do not guess product/model names.

fast_non_pro_coder.use: Bounded ordinary implementation after interface/test freeze

reasoning_non_pro.use: FFI, protocols, ownership/concurrency, persistence, security and integration

reasoning_non_pro_test_author.use: Independent observable contracts, valid RED, adversarial fixtures

reasoning_non_pro_reviewer.use: Independent code review and exact-revision test verification

independence: Separate implementer/test-author/verifier identities and file authority. Different model names alone do not prove independence.

retry_policy.escalation: Return minimal reproduction to a stronger authorized non-Pro reasoning role; no scope/test change by worker.

live_canary.credential: runtime approved environment or protected store only; never stored here
live_canary.budget_approval: pending; live dispatch blocked until set

must_include: exact base SHA and owned file
